name: Glass
author: Gordon Wan
description: Milky-glass control panel: frosted window opacity, compositor blur, rounding, and dim — 8 preset styles, sync-all, style tour, undo — sliders in the bar, live-apply on drag.

barWidget.description: Slide frost, blur, rounding, and dim from the bar. 8 preset styles (light/dark/sheer/utility), ⇅ sync all apps, per-app keep-solid, undo, right-click style tour. Frost rewrites looknfeel.lua and reloads; blur and shapes apply live.
